item.description: The state's record (productGuid, productType, id, weightPerUnit, analyteWeight, serviceCenterId), its values passed through as given.

price_cents.description: Whole cents 0..1000000; anything else is a refusal.

dose.description: initial or secondary; anything else is a refusal.

qty.description: A whole number 1..999; anything else is a refusal.

strain.description: The record's lot's strain, for its notes (SALE-20); anything but text is no strain.

lot_tpe.description: The record's lot's TPE in mg/g from its lab report, for its notes (SALE-20); anything but a finite number above 0 and at least the item's analyteWeight is no TPE.
